description: This file contains a PHP class Filter which is a controller in the Opencart admin extension, responsible for rendering the filter module configuration page and handling its save operation.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class for managing the filter module settings in the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the filter module configuration page including breadcrumbs, header, footer, and the current status of the module.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the filter module settings, including permission checks and responding with success or error messages.
